WRITTEN RESOLUTION OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF ZAMEEN ALPHA (PRIVATE) LIMITED ON THIS 2 7 TH DAY OF JUNE 2019 
 
 The undersigned, being the Directors of Zameen Alpha (Private) Limited (“ Company ”), hereby consent to and adopt in writing the following resolutions on this 2 7 th day of June 2019: 
 
 Resolved that, Hasan Danish , acting as duly authorized representative of the Company, is hereby authorized to enter into, sign, execute, and deliver various documents and such other instruments before government authorities, departments, or person s exercising executive, legislative, judicial, regulatory or administrative functions on behalf of the Government of Pakistan or any other competent authority as may be required and necessary on behalf of the Company, from time to time, in order to effect the sale and transfer of propert y located at 35-A, Police Station Road, Rawalpindi Cantt ., Rawalpindi in favour of Mall 35 , a partnership firm , in compliance with applicable law(s). 
 
 Resolved further that Hasan Danish is hereby authorized to do all such acts, deeds, and things as may be required and necessary in this regard on behalf of the Company, from time to time, in order to complete the transaction stated above . 
 
 We, the Directors of Zameen Alpha (Private) Limited, agree to passing of the above resolutions and subscribe our signatures in token of our consent on this 2 7 th day of June 2019 . 
 
 
 SIGNED by Imran Ali Khan 
 for and on behalf of Zameen Alpha (Private) Limited
